cohort: 8721 newborns born between 2017 and 2020 in a high-risk pregnancy care hospital.
finding: A positive direct antiglobulin Coombs test was significantly associated with maternal/neonatal ABO and RhD blood group incompatibility, impacting various neonatal variables.
mod_finding: Birth by caesarean section was associated with positive DAT result.
birth_weight: Babies with birth weight < 2500 g had significantly higher odds of positive DAT result.
